mapper.sql: achievement.achievement_id AS "achievementId",achievement.evaluation_year AS "evaluationYear",achievement.owner_user_id AS "ownerUserId",achievement.organization_code AS "organizationCode",achievement.management_item_code AS "managementItemCode",achievement.occurred_date AS "occurredDate",achievement.achievement_detail AS "achievementDetail",achievement.certification_status AS "certificationStatus",achievement.attachment_ref AS "attachmentReference",achievement.updated_at AS "updatedAt"

sql.where: achievement.deleted_yn='N' AND (achievement.owner_user_id=#{userId} OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM organization_user_mappings mapping WHERE mapping.user_id=#{userId} AND mapping.organization_code=achievement.organization_code AND mapping.status='ACTIVE' AND mapping.effective_start_date <= CURRENT_DATE AND (mapping.effective_end_date IS NULL OR mapping.effective_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE))) AND achievement.evaluation_year=#{criteria.evaluationYear} AND achievement.organization_code=#{criteria.organizationCode} AND achievement.certification_status=#{criteria.certificationStatus} AND achievement.management_item_code=#{criteria.managementItemCode}

mapper.select: SELECT FROM degree_completion_achievements achievement ORDER BY achievement.occurred_date DESC,achievement.achievement_id DESC LIMIT #{criteria.safeSize} OFFSET #{criteria.offset}
SELECT FROM degree_completion_achievements achievement WHERE achievement.achievement_id=#{achievementId} AND achievement.deleted_yn='N'

SELECT degree_type AS "degreeType",student_name AS "studentName",thesis_title AS "thesisTitle",degree_awarded_date AS "degreeAwardedDate" FROM degree_completion_students WHERE achievement_id=#{achievementId} ORDER BY degree_awarded_date,degree_completion_student_id

SELECT achievement_id FROM degree_completion_achievements WHERE owner_user_id=#{ownerUserId} AND evaluation_year=#{request.evaluationYear} AND management_item_code=#{request.managementItemCode} AND occurred_date=#{request.occurredDate} AND deleted_yn='N' ORDER BY achievement_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE degree_completion_achievements SET evaluation_year=#{request.evaluationYear},organization_code=#{request.organizationCode},management_item_code=#{request.managementItemCode},occurred_date=#{request.occurredDate},achievement_detail=COALESCE(CAST(#{request.achievementDetail,typeHandler=kr.ac.knue.commonfoundation.achievement.AchievementDetailJsonTypeHandler} AS jsonb),'{}'::jsonb),attachment_ref=#{request.attachmentReference},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=#{updatedBy} WHERE achievement_id=#{request.achievementId} AND deleted_yn='N'
